abstract: The hypothalamic arcuate nucleus (Arc) is a central regulator of metabolism. We show that capillaries with sparse fenestrae enable direct and rapid hormone transport into the Arc. Arc fenestrae are virtually absent during pregnancy and obesity, but reform postpartum and upon weight-loss. Fenestrated Arc endothelial cells display a unique hybrid BBB-permeable structural and molecular phenotype, which can be regulated by Wnt signaling. The Arc endothelium exhibits functional plasticity that may affect hypothalamic sensing of systemic metabolic signals.
